speaker: Edward
en: Sorry about the swift exit. Bit of a misunderstanding.

speaker: Bonnet
en: One heaped upon another.

speaker: Edward
en: Ah, Jaysus. I'm sorry mate, this is my doing. I'm only trying to keep these Spanish eyes off me.

speaker: Bonnet
en: Oh, it's no bother. Regrettably, these soldiers confiscated my sugar. And your dispatches.

speaker: Edward
en: Damn! And where've they gone?

speaker: Bonnet
en: I haven't the foggiest idea, I'm afraid. I suspect those chaps might but my Spanish is muy malidad (very evil), so I'd—I'd rather not ask.

speaker: Edward
en: Shit. All right. Come on, let's follow 'em and recover my maps.

speaker: Edward
en: Shit. Come on, let's give ear to their talk, and recover my maps.

speaker: Bonnet
en: And my sugar?

speaker: Edward
en: What, in my drawers? We'll see what happens.

speaker: Bonnet
en: You don't mind me tagging along, do you?

speaker: Edward
en: Not if you keep quiet and stay out of sight. Bonnet!

speaker: Bonnet
en: I believe I'm getting the hang of this!

speaker: Edward
en: Quiet!

speaker: Bonnet
en: I fear they're on to us!

speaker: Edward
en: Hang back!

speaker: Bonnet
en: Oh. Perhaps we should split up to confuse them.

speaker: Edward
en: It's the best idea you've had today.

speaker: Merchant
en: Buenos dias, señores (Hello, sirs). You're late.

speaker: Soldier
en: Yes sir. Si. (Yes). We are very sorry. Our Captain delayed us.

speaker: Merchant
en: This would be Captain Mendoza?

speaker: Soldier
en: Yes, Sir. He is very excited to meet you. Only he must be present for a... a... a hanging, señor (sir).

speaker: Merchant
en: Hanging? Ah... love a good hanging!

speaker: Soldier
en: Yes, very nice. If we hear the bell we may go, if you like!

speaker: Merchant
en: I'd love to. Especially, if Captain Mendoza is pulling the trap. The man owes me money for the slaves I sold him.

speaker: Soldier
en: Of course, Sir. Captain Mendoza is happy to pay you. We have goods to sell. Sugars and such.

speaker: Merchant
en: Excellent.

speaker: Soldier
en: The bell, Señor! (Sir!) The hanging will be started soon!

speaker: Merchant
en: Well, let's not dilly-dally!

speaker: Soldier
en: Yes, Sir. We go!

speaker: Merchant
en: How long will this hanging take, man? I don't mean to hang about all day for the captain.

speaker: Soldier
en: Quick as anything, sir. Captain Mendoza needs only to hang the man, then he will deliver your payment.

speaker: Merchant
en: I don't want reales, mind. I want goods. Things I can sell. Tobacco. Rum. Sugar.

speaker: Soldier
en: Si, si! (Yes, Yes!) We have much fine sugar. Crates we took off a fat Englishman last night.

speaker: Merchant
en: Englishman?

speaker: Soldier
en: Si. (Yes.) Sugar from Barbados. Very fine. We hold it in the Castillo after the man started the fight last night. He ran, left his sugar behind. Very fine.

speaker: Merchant
en: Well that's a start. Shall I accompany him to the Castillo?

speaker: Soldier
en: No sir. Captain Mendoza will have it sent to you, I believe. You will see.

speaker: Merchant
en: Good lord! Is that big brute your Captain Mendoza?

speaker: Soldier
en: No sir. He is El Tiburón. El Tiburón, Governor Torres' man.

speaker: Soldier 1
en: We, ah... stashed their goods to sell. The sugar and such. Hey Carlos. You hear that Captain Mendoza ordered us to take the fat Englishman's goods last night?

speaker: Soldier 2
en: I've been briefed on the matter. The Captain will inspect them after the hanging. I believe a buyer has been arranged.

speaker: Soldier 1
en: That was fast. And when is the hanging?

speaker: Soldier 2
en: The bell! It's starting!

speaker: Edward
en: This Captain Mendoza plans to move our goods. Can't have that.

speaker: Bonnet
en: I've never seen a hanging before. Barbaric! We are going to watch, aren't we?

speaker: Edward
en: Not this time, mate. Better if you stay out of sight.

speaker: Bonnet
en: Of course, of course. Someone needs to be at the ship, should they return the goods.

speaker: Civilian 1
en: They say this pirate sank one of Mendoza's ships.

speaker: Civilian 2
en: I just hope he wasn't tortured before his death sentence.

speaker: Town Crier
en: Come all to witness the final moments of notorious pirate, Samuel Calstock. Venid todos a presenciar los momentos finales del famoso pirata Samuel Calstock. (Come all to witness the final moments of notorious pirate, Samuel Calstock). Our most distinguished and venerable Captain Mendoza will preside over the execution. Nuestro muy distinguido y honorable capitán Mendoza presidirá la ejecución. (Our most distinguished and venerable Captain Mendoza will preside over the execution.)

speaker: Soldier 3
en: The last hanging I saw was a big old sheep-shearing Welshman. Popped his head right off his neck.

speaker: Slaver
en: A hanging is all well and good. I've come for Captain Mendoza. He wouldn't be dodging his debts now, would he?

speaker: Soldier 3
en: No, no. The man on the platform there is the Captain.

speaker: Slaver
en: Ah. Then let the show begin!

speaker: Mendoza
en: For the crimes of forgery, arson, smuggling, theft, and murder, all in the name of piracy, Samuel Calstock, you are hereby sentenced to be hanged by the neck until dead. Do you have any last words?

speaker: Calstock
en: Like many of you, I came to the West Indies for a better life. It is my view...

speaker: Mendoza
en: Let it be known that we offer no quarter to pirates and smugglers in Havana.

speaker: Mendoza
en: Ah, Señor. You've come for the sugar.

speaker: Slaver
en: I've come to see your debts paid.

speaker: Mendoza
en: Si. Indeed. Follow me.

speaker: Mendoza
en: Have you enjoyed your time in Havana?

speaker: Slaver
en: I am only here to collect what's owed. I too have debtors, captain.

speaker: Mendoza
en: Surely you have time for the local girls and local drink, Señor?

speaker: Slaver
en: A public hanging is enough fun for one day. I'm told there is a curious bauble amongst the cargo you seized.

speaker: Mendoza
en: In truth, I cannot say what it is. But if you have more slaves to trade, it could be yours. You will see it for yourself soon enough, Señor. The Castillo is just ahead.

speaker: Edward
en: The Castillo? I'll just slip in and out with my goods.

speaker: Soldier 4
en: If anyone got into the Castillo they'd never reach the top alive.

speaker: Soldier 5
en: The Captain says he wants double guard on the upper store room, so that's what we do. Don't think so much.

speaker: Edward
en: My stuff is nearby.

speaker: Mendoza
en: We have more sugar than we owe, that is certain, Señor. Perhaps you will want that as well?

speaker: Slaver
en: Perhaps. But my interests lie with this bauble you've been teasing. Let's see it.

speaker: Mendoza
en: It is safely locked away. Let us settle the sugar first.

speaker: Edward
en: This Mendoza has a key that I should like to get my hands on.

speaker: Edward
en: Found a key. Let's see if it works.

speaker: Edward
en: Here's my goods. Time to tell Bonnet the bad news.

speaker: Edward
en: Sorry about the sugar. I've only one pair of hands.

speaker: Bonnet
en: Oh, it's no great loss. Uh, I've got a... plenty of cargo here to make a profit of my trip.

speaker: Edward
en: Will you stay here long?

speaker: Bonnet
en: For a few weeks, yes. Then back to Barbados, to the tedium of domesticity.

speaker: Edward
en: Don't settle for tedium. Sail for Nassau. Live life as you see fit.

speaker: Bonnet
en: Haven't I heard that Nassau is crawling with pirates? Seems a very tawdry place.

speaker: Edward
en: Not tawdry. Liberated.

speaker: Bonnet
en: Oh, God, that would be an adventure. But no, no... I'm a husband and a father, I have responsibilities. Life can't be all pleasure and distraction, Duncan.

speaker: Edward
en: Hey, ah, Bonnet. The name's Edward, in truth. Duncan's only a handle.

speaker: Bonnet
en: Ah... a secret name for your secret meeting with the governor.

speaker: Edward
en: The governor, right. I think I've kept him waiting long enough.

speaker: Edward
en: Jaysus, Adé. What the hell happened here?

speaker: Adéwalé
en: You happened here, Edward. The damage you caused six years ago has not been undone.

speaker: Edward
en: I'm not an easy man to call a friend, am I? Is that why you're here?

speaker: Adéwalé
en: To fight beside a man so driven by personal gain and glory is a hard thing, Edward. And I have come to feel the Assassins—and their creed—a more honourable course. Have I been unfair?

speaker: Edward
en: No. For years I've been rushing around, taking whatever I fancied, not giving a tinker's curse for those I hurt. Yet here I am... with riches and reputation, feeling no wiser than when I left home. Yet when I turn around, and look at the course I've run... here's not a man or woman that I love left standing beside me.

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: There is time to make amends, captain Kenway.

speaker: Edward
en: Mary... before she died she asked me to do good by her. To sort out the mess I'd made. Can you help me?

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: Mary was fond of you, Edward. She saw something in your bearing that gave her hope you might one day fight with us.

speaker: Edward
en: Aye, she told me.

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: And what do you think of our creed?

speaker: Edward
en: It's hard to say. For if nothing is true, then why believe anything? And if everything is permitted... why not chase every desire?

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: Why indeed?

speaker: Edward
en: It might be that this idea is only the beginning of wisdom, and not its final form.

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: That's quite a step up from the Edward I met here many years ago.

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: So what do you think?

speaker: Edward
en: It'll take some getting used to.

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: The second attack this month. I should have moved this village long ago.

speaker: Edward
en: I brought all this upon you years ago. But I will stand by you now.

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: It will take more than a few favours to call yourself a true Assassin, Edward.

speaker: Edward
en: One thing at a time, mate.

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: Under attack once more. Come.

speaker: Assassin
en: To the beach!

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: Stay close, Edward. Follow my lead.

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: So many dead... so many injured!

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Good to see you here, breddah! Swift and clean, Edward! Merciful kills are all they deserve!

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: Edward! Find the man who led this attack! Finish him off!

speaker: Edward
en: That coward is hiding aboard his ship.

speaker: Captain
en: Check your muskets and pistols! All ashore! Take your positions! Keep your sabers at the ready! Hold the line, and prepare to advance on my signal!)

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: And once more you have our thanks, Edward. You are welcome here.

speaker: Edward
en: Thank you, sir. I'll rest here a time before setting out, if I may.

speaker: Edward
en: How's her child?

speaker: Ah Tabai
en: She's a strong woman. But not invincible.

speaker: Anne
en: Edward...

speaker: Edward
en: I'm sorry for your loss.

speaker: Anne
en: If I'd stayed in prison, they'd have taken him from me. But he'd now be alive. Might be this is God's way of saying I'm not fit to be a mother yet. Carrying on like I do. Cursing, and drinking, and fighting.

speaker: Edward
en: You are a fighter, aye. In prison, I hear stories of the infamous Anne Bonny and Mary Read, the King's Navy together. Just the pair of you.

speaker: Anne
en: It's all true. And we'd have won that day if Jack and his lads weren't passed out in the hold from drink. Edward... everyone's gone, aren't they? Mary. Rackham. Thatch. And all the rest. I miss them so, rough as they were. Do you feel that too? All empty inside, like...

speaker: Edward
en: I do. Devil curse me, I do.

speaker: Anne Bonny
en: Maynard's got a few less Ships now, and he'll have trouble finding Crew for the rest without his Treasurer. But we still don't know where the crafty Bastard is.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: In point of Fact... I might. The Treasurer let slip Maynard keeps a Villa on the Beckford Estate, at Tortuga.

speaker: Anne
en: And you're just telling me this now?

speaker: Edward
en: I... didn't think much of it at first.

speaker: Lucy Baldwin
en: Ah... I know the Place. It's not heavily guarded. It shouldn't be hard.

speaker: Anne
en: I suppose that's our best Course, then. But I'm still putting out Word for News of him, on the chance we're wrong.

speaker: Edward
en: When we reach Tortuga, I'll go in alone, look around first.

speaker: Anne
en: Take Lucy. If she knows the Place, she'll be of some help.

speaker: Edward
en: We're agreed, then.

speaker: Anne
en: Haul away, lads, and set Course for Tortuga! We go to settle with Maynard!

speaker: Lucy
en: I won't be sorry to have some of Maynard's Gold in my Pocket after this.

speaker: Abel Galvão
en: It does say the Wealth of the Sinner is laid up for the Just. Though thinking ourselves Just, might be a little... hopeful.

speaker: Tobias Smith
en: Gold has no luster for the Dead.

speaker: Lucy
en: I remember Tortuga well. It's a curious place for Maynard to involve himself with.

speaker: Tobias
en: Any Port in a Storm.

speaker: Galvão
en: "The Wicked flee when no man pursues." Or so it says.

speaker: Tobias
en: Not too close.

speaker: Lucy
en: We're swimming? We're Sailors, have you not heard of Boats?

speaker: Anne
en: I'll bring the Jackdaw away so as not to be seen. We'll return at the sign of Trouble.

speaker: Lucy
en: This Place belongs to the Beckford Family, a right Pack of Bastards.

speaker: Edward
en: I availed myself of their hospitality at Eleuthera.

speaker: Lucy
en: Hmm. I'll introduce you. You'll get on.

speaker: Lucy
en: Seeing as we're here to steal Gold, we should probably rob the Place.

speaker: Edward
en: That's the Plan.

speaker: Edward
en: Keep up, but stay hidden.

speaker: Lucy
en: How do we get the Gold back to the Ship?

speaker: Edward
en: I'll figure that out when we find it.

speaker: Lucy
en: It's just you and me, and a lot of Guards.

speaker: Edward
en: Stop worrying. You're about to get paid.

speaker: Lucy
en: Did the Treasurer's Letter say anything about guarding the Place?

speaker: Edward
en: No.

speaker: Lucy
en: Don't you think that's a little odd, considering all these Soldiers?

speaker: Edward
en: I am beginning to.

speaker: Lucy
en: I'm all for Skullduggery. I like it as a Rule. But it doesn't feel right lying to the Crew. I only just met them.

speaker: Edward
en: They'll thank us soon enough when their pockets are heavy with Coin.

speaker: Edward
en: I'll take this Floor. You go Upstairs.

speaker: Lucy
en: Good Idea. You look for the Gold, I'll search out Excuses to tell the Crew.

speaker: Edward
en: We're just Animals to hunt for this Bastard.

speaker: Edward
en: All puffed up like a Cockalorum.

speaker: Lucy
en: There's nothing here. Wait... is that a Letter?

speaker: Robert Maynard
en: My dearest Captain Kenway, the Gold was a Ruse, I'm afraid. Ungentlemanly of me, I suppose, to take advantage of your childlike Avarice. But it was just so easy. In my absence, I leave you to my Soldiers. Warmest Regards, soon to be Captain Robert Maynard.

speaker: Edward
en: Arrogant Bastard!

speaker: Lucy
en: Bad News?

speaker: Edward
en: We've been tricked.

speaker: Lucy
en: Ah... Captain? Isn't that a Powder Barrel?

speaker: British Officer
en: If they come out, kill them! The rest of you, to the Beach!

speaker: Lucy
en: The Jackdaw! Thank Christ our Quartermaster is paying Attention. Not that I haven't enjoyed the Nostalgia, but... we should leave!

speaker: British Soldier 1
en: Them Pirates are at the Beach. Let's go!

speaker: British Soldier 2
en: What about the Villa?

speaker: British Soldier 1
en: You heard the Captain. Move it!

speaker: Edward
en: Go! I'll catch you up.

speaker: Edward
en: Shit.

speaker: Anne
en: What the Hell happened?

speaker: Edward
en: It was a Trap. Let's get out of here.

speaker: Anne
en: I'll want more of an explanation than that, once we're clear. Full Sail!

speaker: Lucy
en: Ships!

speaker: Anne
en: That's a Fleet! We're ambushed!

speaker: Edward
en: There's nothing else for it. We'll sink them one at a time!

speaker: Anne
en: They knew we were coming! Fucking Maynard, he knew!

speaker: Edward
en: With luck he's on one of those Ships.

speaker: Galvão
en: How did we miss them when we came in?

speaker: Tobias
en: The odds are not in our Favor.

speaker: Lucy
en: You think?

speaker: Tobias
en: Live or die, we can Fight.

speaker: Galvão
en: I've been in worse, and survived.

speaker: Lucy
en: That's it. More Words like that.

speaker: Anne
en: There's more of them! We've more Work to do yet, Lads!

speaker: Galvão
en: More Hulls for the Ocean Floor!

speaker: Tobias
en: They'll follow their Comrades to Hell.

speaker: Lucy
en: That's going to be quite the Ship Graveyard.

speaker: Anne
en: All right, Edward, explain yourself. All of it, now. What happened at Tortuga?

speaker: Edward
en: It was a Trap. Maynard was never there.

speaker: Anne
en: And Gold was the Bait he used to trap you, no Doubt. Damned Fool, we could have all been killed.

speaker: Edward
en: The Treasurer had a Letter that said Maynard kept his Warchest at Tortuga. He must have known we got his Treasurer, and read the Letter. He knew we'd follow it.

speaker: Anne
en: Of course he bloody did. Jesus Edward. Have you forgotten your History? You were so focused on the Gold you missed it.

speaker: Edward
en: Missed what?

speaker: Anne
en: The Pirate Capital. He's not talking about Nassau. Maynard's at Port Royal!

speaker: Officer British 03 Male
en: I've been informed Kenway and his Crew are already on their Way! The Lieutenant expects him to go for the Villa, so keep your Eyes open.

speaker: Edward
en: Shit! They knew we were coming. How?

speaker: Edward
en: Looking fierce, Thatch.

speaker: Soldier British 01 Male
en: Blackbeard's dead, you Fool. It's just a Dummy in a Costume.

speaker: Soldier British 02 Male
en: You never saw him up close like I did. Even his likeness gives me the Shivers.

speaker: Soldier British 06 Male
en: Kenway's here! The Pirates are here! Get them!

speaker: Edward
en: Spiced Wine. Piss water for pretentious Sneezers who can't stomach real Drink.

speaker: Soldier British 04 Male
en: Who do you think the Lieutenant's got us waiting for?

speaker: Soldier British 05 Male
en: Whoever they are, they're in for a nasty surprise, aren't they!

speaker: Soldier British 04 Male
en: I heard it was Pirates. I won't mind busting a few of their Rat Heads.

speaker: Soldier British 05 Male
en: That's the kind of Work's that's good for the soul, Mate.

speaker: Lucy
en: Guards, by the Tower.

speaker: Edward
en: Anne will forgive my deception once we have the Gold.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: I thought I might find you here.

speaker: Bernard Woodhouse
en: Captain Kenway. Welcome back.

speaker: Bernard
en: I would like to extend my sincerest thanks for the recovery of Verano House. This Place... this Island... it would not have been possible without you.

speaker: Edward
en: I got paid, didn't I?

speaker: Bernard
en: That may be true, but it does not negate the Efforts you have made. Lady Summers would have rejoiced seeing her Island now. It's Home again.

speaker: Edward
en: Home.

speaker: Edward
en: You told me that your final Task was to fix this Place. What will you do now that it's done?

speaker: Bernard
en: I had planned to leave... But if you will allow it, I would prefer to stay. I've become rather fond of the people here.

speaker: Edward
en: By all means, Bernard. You won't want to see the sorry State of things around here if it's left to me.

speaker: Bernard
en: Goodbye Captain. And thank you.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: Did you happen to hear why the Red Coats should be so interested in her?

speaker: Adéwalé
en: No more than any other Pirate.

speaker: Edward
en: It's strange she warrants such Infamy. I'm interested to hear the Truth of it.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: It's not like you to take us on a mission of good Will without promise of Pay.

speaker: Edward
en: It's not for Amusement, Adé. You know yourself the State of the Ship. We need a decent Shipwright. This Lass is all I've found.

speaker: Edward
en: Stay at a distance, we don't want to raise their Hackles. I'll swim over.

speaker: Edward
en: Easy now.

speaker: British soldier 1
en: I've pulled double duty every Day this Week. There's always something.

speaker: British soldier 2
en: Me as well. It's that new Prisoner Lieutenant Maynard brought in. She's Trouble, mark my Words. None of them Baldwins are any good. They say she murdered her own Grandfather, though he had it coming from what I hear.

speaker: British soldier 1
en: The Apple don't fall far from the Tree. It's a shame though, ain't it? She's a pretty little thing.

speaker: British soldier 2
en: Don't be a Fool! She'd cut your Throat the minute your Back was turned.

speaker: Edward
en: This looks right.

speaker: British soldier 3
en: The new Prisoner's a Baldwin.

speaker: British soldier 4
en: I don't care who she is, she's a Pirate. They're going to stretch her Neck, and good riddance.

speaker: British soldier 5
en: How'd they catch her?

speaker: British soldier 6
en: I didn't hear, only that she fought like a . It took three Men to hold her, and she's no bigger than a .

speaker: Edward
en: I must be close.

speaker: Lucy
en: You're short for a Soldier. Is the Governor taking Children into his Service now?

speaker: British soldier 7
en: You've got a Mouth on you, you little Bilge Rat.

speaker: Lucy
en: Christ! And your Breath smells like Monkey Ass.

speaker: British soldier 7
en: We'll see how Smart you are when the Rope's around your Neck, and you dance the Hempen Jig.

speaker: Edward
en: You alright?

speaker: Lucy
en: And who in Blazes are you?

speaker: Edward
en: I'm your passage out of here. Quickly.

speaker: Lucy
en: I don't know you from Blind Bart.

speaker: Edward
en: I'm in need of a Shipwright, and you're in need of better Lodgings.

speaker: Edward
en: That's it, time to go. It's me or the Hangman.

speaker: Lucy
en: You make a fine Argument. Lead on.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: British Ships!

speaker: Edward
en: New Crew onboard. Lucy Baldwin, Shipwright and scourge of the Caribbean.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Welcome aboard.

speaker: Lucy
en: It's a decent enough Tub.

speaker: Edward
en: The Jackdaw's no Tub, I promise you.

speaker: Edward
en: You've pissed off some powerful People.

speaker: Lucy
en: I wish I could take Credit. I've been stitched up.

speaker: Edward
en: You and every Pirate on the open seas, Lass.

speaker: Lucy
en: I'm keen to get some distance from this Place.

speaker: Edward
en: Welcome to the Jackdaw, Shipwright. You can see for yourself, she's no Slouch.

speaker: Lucy
en: You're Ship proud. I respect that.

speaker: Edward
en: She could use some work, if I'm honest. We need your Skill. What say you to joining us?

speaker: Lucy
en: You don't mince Words, do you? I suppose I could look around, see what needs doing. First I need a decent Drink. I had nothing but fouled water in that damned Cell for Days.

speaker: Edward
en: It's a matter of some Urgency, then. We'll have to go Ashore.

speaker: British soldier 1
en: How'd they catch her?

speaker: British soldier 2
en: I didn't hear, only that she fought like a . It took three men to hold her, and she's no bigger than a .

speaker: Edward
en: I must be close.

speaker: British soldier 3
en: You've got a mouth on you, you little bilge rat.

speaker: Lucy
en: Christ! And your breath smells like money ass.

speaker: British soldier 3
en: We'll see how smart you are when the rope's around your neck, and you dance the hempen jig.

speaker: Edward
en: You alright?

speaker: Lucy
en: And who in blazes are you?

speaker: Edward
en: I'm your passage out of here. Quickly.

speaker: Lucy
en: I don't know you from Blind Bart.

speaker: Edward
en: I need a shipwright, and you're in need of better lodgings.

speaker: Edward
en: That's it, time to go. It's me or the hangman.

speaker: Lucy
en: You make a fine argument. Lead on.

speaker: Edward
en: You've pissed off some powerful people.

speaker: Lucy
en: I wish I could take credit. I've been stitched up.

speaker: Edward
en: You and every pirate on the open seas, lass.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: British ships!

speaker: Lucy
en: It's a decent enough tub.

speaker: Edward
en: The Jackdaws no tub, I promise you.

speaker: Edward
en: New crew onboard. Lucy Baldwin. Shipwright and scourge of the Caribbean.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Welcome aboard.

speaker: Lucy
en: I'm keen to get some distance from this place.

speaker: Edward
en: Welcome to the Jackdaw, shipwright. You can see for yourself, she's no slouch.

speaker: Lucy
en: You're ship proud. I respect that.

speaker: Edward
en: She could use some work, if I'm honest. We need your skill. What say you to joining us?

speaker: Lucy
en: I suppose I could look around, see what needs doing.

speaker: Lucy
en: First I need a decent drink. I had nothing but fouled water in that cell for days.

speaker: Edward
en: It's a matter of some urgency, then. We'll have to go ashore.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: We're headed to Punta del Caracol, Boys. There's someone I'd like to meet.

speaker: Edward
en: The Padre's on that Island.

speaker: Abel Galvão
en: I have been to Kingston. The there are... territorial. And not welcoming to .

speaker: British civilian 1
en: They even tried to ban us from their town. We're safer here.

speaker: British civilian 2
en: Bishop Ravenscroft has been calling us to Kingston for Years to help the Catholics there. I fear he is losing patience.

speaker: Galvão
en: And I fear God, not His Servant. My Answer remains the same. We stay here.

speaker: British civilian 2
en: Is that a Pirate? What's he doing here?

speaker: Edward
en: You're the one they call Padre.

speaker: Galvão
en: I am. Welcome to our Village if you come in Peace.

speaker: Galvão
en: Our Lot is simple. Farmers, Fishermen and their Families. You'll find Prizes elsewhere.

speaker: Edward
en: You misunderstand me. I am told that you were once a fearsome Master-at-Arms. I need someone of your Quality to keep my Crew in Line.

speaker: Galvão
en: It has been some Years since I was last on the Account. That Pirate is dead and the World is better for it.

speaker: Edward
en: A Man with your Talents would find the limitations of religious Life chafing, I would imagine. Don't you miss being free, and the Master of your own Destiny?

speaker: Galvão
en: As you're here already, could you let the People know the Food is ready? It is in these small Services to each other, that we serve God.

speaker: Edward
en: You need time to think. Why not.

speaker: Edward
en: This one is not going to be easy.

speaker: Edward
en: Hello, the Padre says it's Time to eat.

speaker: British civilian 3
en: Thank you. We'll make our way over.

speaker: British civilian 4
en: How many Men do you think he's killed?

speaker: British civilian 5
en: Who? The Pirate?

speaker: British civilian 4
en: No, the Padre.

speaker: British civilian 5
en: Oh, Scores uncounted. But that was a long time ago. He's a new man now.

speaker: Henry Congreve
en: And who might you be?

speaker: Edward
en: I'm Edward, a Friend. The Padre sent me to tell you the Food is ready.

speaker: Henry
en: All wrapped up in Pirate Garb, you're not with Du Casse are you?

speaker: Edward
en: Du Casse? I'm reliably informed he won't be bothering anyone again.

speaker: Henry
en: Met his End, did he? Well, I can't say I'm sorry. Don't tell the Padre I said that.

speaker: Dinah Calverley
en: Now, who's that handsome Devil?

speaker: Edward
en: My name's Edward Kenway, and I am no Devil today. Just a humble Servant bringing Word that the Food is ready.

speaker: Dinah
en: Edward, a Pleasure. I am Dinah Calverley. Now, my Legs feel dreadful today. Could you be a Dear and fetch me my Plate?

speaker: Edward
en: Anything for the Lady of the Manor.

speaker: Dinah
en: Oh, aren't you a Charmer.

speaker: Galvão
en: All done?

speaker: Edward
en: Not quite. The kind old Lady has turned me into her Errand Boy.

speaker: Galvão
en: Ah, Mistress Calverley. Be careful of that one. She'll have you running Errands all day.

speaker: Dinah
en: Thank you, young Man. Now, where did you say you were from?

speaker: Edward
en: Wales by way of Bristol, to which I intend to return.

speaker: Dinah
en: And I pray that you do one Day, so you might see again those you left behind. I've lived here most of my Life, and it's the People who make it Home.

speaker: Galvão
en: My People and I are thankful. And word is that you rid us of the threats from Du Casse.

speaker: Edward
en: Join me, and you'll have the Chance to rid the world of more of Du Casse's Ilk, and get rich yourself along the way. Gold will help your people where good intentions cannot.

speaker: Galvão
en: I have chosen my Path. It's not Gold that will save our Souls.

speaker: Edward
en: I myself cannot make the same choice.

speaker: Galvão
en: God has given me a second Chance, and I will not squander it. But, perhaps there is one more Thing I can ask of you.

speaker: Edward
en: What is it?

speaker: Galvão
en: There's a persistent Rumor that what's left of Du Casse's Men, four Ships total, anchor nearby. I wish to know what they have planned.

speaker: Edward
en: I can see about these Rogues. They're sure to have some Reales that are not rightly theirs.

speaker: Edward
en: We need to talk.

speaker: Anne
en: We do. All of us.

speaker: Edward
en: My Quarters, then, when we reach Port Royal.

speaker: Anne Bonny
en: Tortuga was a Trap, but it wasn't a total Loss. We know where Maynard's gone.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: There was a letter on the Treasurer. We think he's at Port Royal.

speaker: Abel Galvão
en: It's another Trap, a Classic double Feint.

speaker: Tobias Smith
en: He knows we're coming.

speaker: Edward
en: Maybe, but he doesn't know when. Maynard's down to half his Ships at least, some of them not seaworthy and without full Crews. He's vulnerable. We won't get another chance like this.

speaker: Lucy Baldwin
en: What of his Gold?

speaker: Anne
en: Christ Almighty, not you as well!

speaker: Edward
en: Peace Anne. We do this right, and Maynard won't trouble us again.

speaker: Anne
en: All right, let's get on with it, then. No Tricks this time!

speaker: Galvão
en: There's rumor Maynard can't hire enough Crew for his Ships, so he's forcing Men into Servitude.

speaker: Edward
en: I'm not surprised to hear it.

speaker: Galvão
en: The Man has no Honour.

speaker: Edward
en: Maynard's not concerned with Honour, Mate.

speaker: Anne
en: I know you, Edward. Your mind's still on Maynard's Gold as much as it's on him.

speaker: Edward
en: I don't deny it. I want Maynard, don't mistake me. I'll take his Gold as well if I can.

speaker: Anne
en: I don't fault you for it. But you're Captain to this Crew. If it comes to a Choice, and it might... what then?

speaker: Edward
en: We all know our Parts? I'll help where I can. Once you're done, get to the southern Dock. The Jackdaw will meet us there. Lucy, find the Gunpowder Store and ruin it any way you can.

speaker: Lucy
en: Got it.

speaker: Edward
en: Padre, find and free the press-ganged Sailors. Smith... you go blow things up. When all is ready, I'll find Maynard's Warship, and send it to the Bottom. Then, with Luck, we'll find Maynard.

speaker: Soldier British 05 Male
en: Get off Woman! The Lieutenant has need of his Service.

speaker: Citizen British 01 Female
en: No! Mercy! He's my only Son! Leave us be!

speaker: Soldier British 05 Male
en: Get off, or I'll Clip your Ear for you!

speaker: Citizen British 03 Male
en: He's a great man, Lieutenant Maynard is. Ain't no other Captain has done what he has. Blackbeard had all the others on the Run. They couldn't find the Devil, and when they did they couldn't handle him. Not Maynard! He chased him all over the Ocean, hunted him down like a mad Dog, and put an end to him. Who else could have done that? I ask you!

speaker: Edward
en: Jaysus!

speaker: Citizen British 01 Female
en: What in God's Name was that!

speaker: Citizen British 02 Female
en: It must be the Soldiers training. What else could it be?

speaker: Citizen British 01 Female
en: Well... I wish they'd do it with less Noise.

speaker: Edward
en: Were those Fireworks your doing?

speaker: Tobias
en: Come.

speaker: Edward
en: Where did you learn this Skill?

speaker: Edward
en: It's your Secret, then.

speaker: Tobias
en: First we gather the Lobsters. Hold your Ears.

speaker: Edward
en: What?

speaker: Tobias
en: Finished here. Leave the rest to me.

speaker: Edward
en: I'll find you at the southern Dock, after I deal with Maynard's Ship.

speaker: Lucy
en: This way. Shh! Come along. The Powder Stores are up ahead, but I'll need your help with the Guards... quietly.

speaker: Lucy
en: Careful! Guards there.

speaker: Soldier British 03 Male
en: If the Lieutenant took greater care, there'd be no Need to repair his Ships so often.

speaker: Lucy
en: That's the lot. Easier than I expected with both of us. Now we'll ruin their Powder.

speaker: Edward
en: You take care of the Rest. I'm going ahead.

speaker: Galvão
en: Captain! Up here.

speaker: Edward
en: Have you found the Sailors?

speaker: Galvão
en: Si. Maynard's got them locked up in the Prison. If we free them, they might be persuaded to help us fight.

speaker: Galvão
en: They're nearby now.

speaker: Edward
en: Do you miss your Church, Padre?

speaker: Galvão
en: Sim, claro. (Yes, of course.) I miss the People. It was my Life.

speaker: Edward
en: I've never really understood Religion. I believe in Myself, the Strength in my own Hands, my own Reason. No offense.

speaker: Galvão
en: That's a common view. Of course I understand it well. I saw things the same way once. There are times I still do.

speaker: Galvão
en: You're free, by the Grace of God. Get away, quickly.

speaker: Edward
en: You take care of the Rest.

speaker: Galvão
en: My Friends you are free. Do not be ashamed if you surrendered Information under Duress. Few men can pass such a Test. If you need God's Forgiveness, only seek it, and it will be found. Vengeance is mine saith the Lord, but do not forget what Maynard did to you. Vengeance can be yours Today if you will fight. If it is not in your Heart to help give Maynard what he deserves, be assured we will do it.

speaker: Edward
en: This doesn't seem grand enough to be Maynard's Warship.

speaker: Edward
en: The faster I work, the less Chance I'm discovered.

speaker: Edward
en: There's still time to look around a bit.

speaker: Edward
en: What's this?

speaker: Edward
en: The Gold! This changes things.

speaker: Edward
en: Maynard's Gold could be at the Church.

speaker: Edward
en: Shit! The others will be waiting for me... I'll see to them first.

speaker: Edward
en: Good, you all made it. Call for the Jackaw. There's one more thing I have to do.

speaker: Lucy
en: Are you mad? It's time to go.

speaker: Galvão
en: Oh, this is not good.

speaker: Edward
en: This is too easy.

speaker: Soldier British 03 Male
en: The Lieutenant knew you'd come at the Smell of Treasure! But you're too late.

speaker: Edward
en: This won't end in your Favor.

speaker: Soldier British 04 Male
en: The Gold's gone, Pirate!

speaker: Edward
en: But you're here, aren't you?

speaker: Soldier British 05 Male
en: We were expecting you, you filthy Prigger. You've stolen your last Coin.

speaker: Edward
en: I seriously doubt that.

speaker: Edward
en: Maynard's been a step ahead the whole way. Shit, my Officers!

speaker: Edward
en: Oh, Shit!

speaker: Edward
en: Oh, Shit!

speaker: Edward
en: Get to Cover!

speaker: Edward
en: Anne's going to have my Guts.

speaker: Edward
en: Maynard played me like a Fiddle.

speaker: Edward
en: The Jackdaw! Well done, Anne. You're not getting away this time, Maynard.

speaker: Edward
en: We have to go! Maynard's got the others.

speaker: Anne
en: I know he has, I watched him take them! Where the hell were you, Edward? No! Don't tell me. Jesus Christ!

speaker: Edward
en: We'll get them, Anne. But we have to go, now!

speaker: Anne
en: Your want of Riches will be the end of us! There's going to be a Reckoning for this Edward. I mean it!

speaker: Anne
en: Let fall the Courses and trim the Topsail lads! We've a Bastard to catch!

speaker: Anne
en: Christ, that's a Beast!

speaker: Edward
en: This is what Maynard was building. Not just an Armada, this floating damned Fortress.

speaker: Anne
en: How the Hell did he hide something that big?

speaker: Edward
en: The Bastard's been ahead of us the whole time.

speaker: Edward
en: Our Guns have almost no effect!

speaker: Anne
en: It's that bloody Armor. We can't breach it!

speaker: Anne
en: There's no use trying to get past that Armor.

speaker: Edward
en: Target the Mines! They'll hit below the Waterline!

speaker: Anne
en: After all the Pains we took finding those three, you let them get taken.

speaker: Edward
en: I know, Anne. But we'll get them. And we'll get Maynard, as well as his Gold.

speaker: Anne
en: If I wasn't in the middle of a Fight with this Monster, I'd start one up with you! What would Thatch say?

speaker: Anne
en: We won't hook easily on that. We'll have to Ram, and you can jump over!

speaker: Lucy
en: Captain!

speaker: Tobias
en: Maynard's got the Key.

speaker: Edward
en: Hold fast. I'll find the Cur.

speaker: Lucy
en: Hurry, will you? The Hold's half filled with Water already...

speaker: Galvão
en: Behind you!

speaker: Edward
en: You fight just like a Pirate.

speaker: Robert Maynard
en: How dare you.

speaker: Maynard
en: You're only here because I intended it.

speaker: Edward
en: You've led me a merry Chase, I don't deny it.

speaker: Maynard
en: It's simply because I'm your better in every way.

speaker: Edward
en: Yet here you are at the point of my Sword... as I intended.

speaker: Edward
en: I hear you've yet to make the Rank of Captain.

speaker: Maynard
en: Once I've killed Edward Kenway they'll give me whatever I ask.

speaker: Edward
en: That's Captain... Edward Kenway.

speaker: Maynard
en: This is a Fight I've long anticipated.

speaker: Edward
en: A bold Gamble for one so lightly skilled.

speaker: Maynard
en: Skilled enough for Blackbeard. Wasn't he your Friend?

speaker: Edward
en: It doesn't take Skill to strike a man from behind. That's Cowardice.

speaker: Maynard
en: Isn't that your kind's specialty?

speaker: Maynard
en: What will it be, Pirate? The Gold you cherish... ...or the Friends you don't?

speaker: Edward
en: NO!

speaker: Edward
en: You'll keep, Shitbird.

speaker: Lucy
en: That was a lot of Gold.

speaker: Tobias
en: That Bastard got away.

speaker: Galvão
en: Yet we survived.

speaker: Anne
en: Aye, We gave the King's Men some Problems. Thatch would be happy at that.

speaker: Edward
en: Thatch... he thought it all a choice between Gold or penniless Valor. For my Part, I agreed but... When it came down to it...

speaker: Anne
en: Edward Kenway. There might be hope for you.

speaker: Lucy
en: To our Captain!

speaker: Anne
en: To our Captain!

speaker: Galvão
en: To our Captain!

speaker: Tobias
en: To our Captain!

speaker: Blackbeard
en: It's one thing to go all soft, Kenway. It's another to pin that new Philosophy on me. I won't have it. Though if you asked me now, I'd tell you it's Friends, not Gold, that make for better Parties.

speaker: Edward
en: We're both late coming to that understanding. I let that Shitbird Maynard get away.

speaker: Blackbeard
en: We all have our Time. Could be it's your Time to stop chasing Fairy Stories, and Rum Dreams. Leave off thinking so much on Tomorrow that you forget about Today. Could be it's your last Day.

speaker: Edward
en: There's nothing certain.

speaker: Blackbeard
en: Ha! There you go again. In point of fact, Kenway, I don't recommend you thinking much at all. It's not your Forte...

speaker: Soldier British 01 Male
en: We've been working at this since first Light.

speaker: Soldier British 02 Male
en: And there's no End in sight, neither.

speaker: Soldier British 01 Male
en: We're not Soldiers. We're little more than Slaves, Mate.

speaker: Soldier British 06 Male
en: Don't be a fool! What do you gain by resisting except your own Suffering.

speaker: Sailor British 03 Male
en: I'm no Man's Servant, much less his Slave! Curse you and your faithless Master.

speaker: Soldier British 06 Male
en: Oh, you're going to be sorry for them Words.

speaker: Soldier British 06 Male
en: Look around!

speaker: Soldier British 04 Male
en: Come on, cough it up. You wouldn't have no profits at all if not for Lieutenant Maynard.

speaker: Soldier British 04 Male
en: And no shirking, neither! The more you give the better the Lieutenant can protect all of our Interests.

speaker: Soldier British 01 Male
en: It's shameful what the Crown's done to Lieutenant Maynard if you ask me.

speaker: Soldier British 05 Male
en: Aye, he's worth twice any of the other Captains.

speaker: Soldier British 01 Male
en: He should have been made Captain long ago.

speaker: Soldier British 05 Male
en: He already does the work of a Captain with none of the Reward.

speaker: Soldier British 03 Male
en: It don't sit right with me, what Maynard's doing.

speaker: Soldier British 04 Male
en: You mean his going behind the Captain's back, and taking all his Men?

speaker: Soldier British 03 Male
en: Aye. There's such a thing as Loyalty, you know? Where would we be if we all just did as we chose?

speaker: Soldier British 04 Male
en: We're just Foot Soldier's, Mate. It don't matter what you or I think at the end of the Day.

speaker: Tobias
en: Last Bit.

speaker: Edward
en: We need to hurry.

speaker: Edward
en: That's done. Why did you not cover your own Ears?

speaker: Tobias
en: It's too late for my ears.

speaker: Edward
en: Now to put the charges on Maynard's Ship.

speaker: Edward
en: Your Ships have a tendency to sink.

speaker: Maynard
en: All according to Plan. Fire!

speaker: Edward
en: You mean to drown my Crew. I won't let it happen.

speaker: Maynard
en: Everything I plan happens.

speaker: Edward
en: This is my last chance for the Gold.

speaker: Edward
en: Not so easy when the Fight's fair.

speaker: Maynard
en: You think you've won?

speaker: Anne
en: What a Mess! Almost makes me miss being at the Old Avery cleaning up empty Mugs and Vomit.

speaker: Edward
en: I don't believe it. You couldn't go back now you've tasted all this.

speaker: Anne
en: Oh, aye? You think so do you? The smell of Black Powder, Sweat, and Filth. My Ears ringing.

speaker: Edward
en: You're all Talk. I see the Fire in your Eyes at every Fight.

speaker: Anne
en: Well... you're right. I love it, and that's the Truth.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: Tell me about this Island we're headed to. Was it your Home?

speaker: Edward
en: All right, I'll go first. I came of age on a Farm. We are Shepherds, us Kenways. But I wanted more, for my Family... for me. So I took to the Seas, and here I am.

speaker: Tobias Smith
en: I was born in Barbados. I've little Memory of it. Maybe I wasn't. Who can say now with all that's happened.

speaker: Edward
en: And Crooked Island?

speaker: Tobias
en: I stole away there as a Youth. Met my Wife. A sunny Place. Fine People. A different Time. A short Time. I fell in with some Pirates. It was them who taught me to use Firearms and Machines. Then the British came. One of their Raids. No warning. Men, Women, Children, no matter. Taken and gone. You know the rest.

speaker: Edward
en: That's over now. Let's hope your Wife awaits your Return with open Arms.

speaker: Tobias
en: It is Hope that's brought me the most Pain these last Years.

speaker: Edward
en: There it is, Crooked Island. There's Smoke.

speaker: Tobias
en: Something's amiss.

speaker: Edward
en: English Ships.

speaker: Tobias
en: A Raid. We must stop them.

speaker: Edward
en: Lead on.

speaker: Portuguese civilian 1
en: Not my Son, please! Take me instead!

speaker: British soldier 1
en: Shut your Mouth.

speaker: British soldier 2
en: Meddlesome Rats! Leave that one Alive, he'll fetch a Sum.

speaker: Portuguese civilian 1
en: Oh, thank you.

speaker: African civilian 1
en: Please, I am old.

speaker: British soldier 3
en: You'll still fetch a Price.

speaker: African civilian 1
en: I owe you my Life.

speaker: African civilian 2
en: Mark, Mark! Wake up, Man!

speaker: British soldier 4
en: Too late for Him. That should teach you lot to try to escape.

speaker: British soldier 5
en: You belong in the Fire!

speaker: British soldier 6
en: Knaves! Off with you!

speaker: African civilian 2
en: Mark, my Friend, we're Saved! Please open your Eyes!

speaker: African civilian 3
en: Thank you, thank you!

speaker: Edward
en: Hah! They fled back to the Sea.

speaker: Tobias
en: They will return.

speaker: Edward
en: This place is safe, for now. Let's find your Home?

speaker: Tobias
en: Yes.

speaker: Edward
en: Lead the Way.

speaker: Edward
en: You're uneasy.

speaker: Tobias
en: I don't know this place like I did. Not no more.

speaker: Edward
en: It has been... some Years. Should I let you get on with it?

speaker: Tobias
en: No. Come. I do not know if my Wife will remember me.

speaker: Edward
en: The House is in ruins. A Grave.

speaker: Tobias
en: My Wife. May she rest.

speaker: Edward
en: She never forgot you.

speaker: Tobias
en: She gave me this. "As long as they persist, so will we," she said. Flowers die, dry, and rot. I did not say it then. I failed her. All Love must end with one saying goodbye to the other. She was my Light. It is Darkness once more.

speaker: Edward
en: I have said goodbye to many Friends, Close and True. The Ache never leaves.

speaker: Tobias
en: Upon my Death, bury me next to she is all I ask.

speaker: Tobias
en: Edward. Thank you. I know little of this World. Almost nothing. But I had to know my Wife's Fate.

speaker: Edward
en: You can be a dark Cloud over calm Waters, Smith. But we'll put some Cheer on those Bones yet. It's been a pleasure to get to know you, Smith.

speaker: Tobias
en: Thank you, Captain.

speaker: Rhona
en: What did you find out?

speaker: Edward
en: Managed to nab a pickpocket. Sly boots had a map. Something about storehouses and gunpowder.

speaker: Rhona
en: I did some research too. It's clear as day: the whole operation's run by that Templar scoundrel, Hilary Flint.

speaker: Edward
en: That's the same name from the map.

speaker: Rhona
en: He's using pickpockets to run an arms race.

speaker: Edward
en: Against who?

speaker: Rhona
en: Me.

speaker: Edward
en: He's in the lead, I take it?

speaker: Rhona
en: Yes, but with your map, we can destroy his weapons stores to catch up.

speaker: Edward
en: Let's waste no time.

speaker: Bernard Woodhouse
en: Are you the new Owner of the House?

speaker: Edward
en: And who are you?

speaker: Bernard
en: My name is Bernard Edmund Woodhouse, the Butler of Verano House.

speaker: Edward
en: Edward Kenway. Du Casse had a Butler?

speaker: Bernard
en: I served the rightful Owner, the Widow Lady Catherine Ann Summers. She was Lady of this Mansion and the Isle it rests upon.

speaker: Edward
en: Is this her?

speaker: Bernard
en: Yes. Lady Summers was committed to this Place. Her Sanctuary, she called it. She wanted a better Life for the People here, and a Home where she could display her Art Collection. It is my final Task. I seek to continue her Work and to fulfill her Wishes. I cannot do it alone.

speaker: Edward
en: I get your meaning. You'd have the Coin from my Pocket fund a Hunt for your Art Pieces.

speaker: Bernard
en: The Locals here require aid, and the Lady's Collection was no doubt sold off and scattered around the Caribbean.

speaker: Edward
en: Why would I bring them here when I could sell them for a Profit elsewhere?

speaker: Bernard
en: Because I will pay three times what anyone else will. You see, the Lady had no other Family left. In her dying Breath, she bequeathed me... enough.

speaker: Edward
en: You drive a hard bargain. I accept.

speaker: Edward
en: Whoever painted this Portrait did him a great Courtesy... or they were well-paid.

speaker: Edward
en: A cautionary tale...

speaker: Edward
en: Horrible Manners, this one.

speaker: Edward
en: Prick.

speaker: Edward
en: Still looking down on your betters, I see, Prins.

speaker: Edward
en: No Artist can fix that face.

speaker: Edward
en: I called him Friend, once.

speaker: Edward
en: This Portrait is the giver of Nightmares.

speaker: Edward
en: The Painter didn't complete his Work. Rest easy, Friend.

speaker: Edward
en: I would have liked to hear those wild Stories he promised.

speaker: Edward
en: Where is Bernard?

speaker: Edward
en: This will make a fine addition.

speaker: Edward
en: This belongs to me now, and it is a worthy Piece.

speaker: Bernard Woodhouse
en: Welcome back, Captain Kenway.

speaker: Edward
en: You move quietly for a Butler.

speaker: Bernard
en: Captain Kenway, I must thank you for your efforts in retrieving the Pieces in my Lady's Collection. Verano House is slowly beginning to remember itself.

speaker: Bernard
en: The Passion Flower. Or, Passiflora Bahamensis. Lady Summers adored them. We would talk about Art, Languages, the World at large. I'd always hoped we'd travel one Day.

speaker: Edward
en: You were fond of her. She would be happy to know how well you've cared for this Place.

speaker: Edward
en: Bernard has to be here somewhere.

speaker: Edward
en: That's a trick I need to learn.

speaker: Bernard
en: Tea, Captain Kenway? I received a new Shipment from the far East, said to be very popular in the Salons of Europe.

speaker: Bernard
en: That's an unusual weapon.

speaker: Edward
en: But useful all the same.

speaker: Bernard
en: I have seen its like before.

speaker: Edward
en: Are you one of them, Bernard? Have I been blind? The way you move, the things you know... I'm not easy to surprise, Bernard, but you've managed it. You are an Assassin, or were.

speaker: Bernard
en: Well done Captain Kenway. Yes. This House was a Bureau, and I its leader.

speaker: Edward
en: Then you have me at an advantage. You knew of me before we met.

speaker: Bernard
en: I am hardly unique in that. You've quite the Reputation. The trail you've left reaches right across the West Indies.

speaker: Edward
en: Why did you stop? Surely your old life was more desirable than this.

speaker: Bernard
en: I got old. No one can Fight forever. Now, I only desire peace, rest, and to live out my remaining Days as Caretaker to my Lady's House.

speaker: Edward
en: I desire far more than that.

speaker: Bernard
en: In time, what is meant for us will find us.

speaker: Edward
en: Bernard! The Collection is complete.

speaker: Edward
en: Bernard.

speaker: Bernard
en: Captain Kenway.

speaker: Edward
en: Quite a sight. What say you, Bernard?

speaker: Bernard
en: From the bottom of my Heart, Captain Kenway, I thank you. You have honoured my Lady's dying wishes, and done what I could not do.

speaker: Edward
en: The House is better for it.

speaker: Bernard
en: This Place was stripped of its Beauty and abused by a Brute, but now... Its dignity has been restored. Thanks to you, Captain Kenway.

speaker: Edward
en: I'm just another Pirate.

speaker: Bernard
en: You have reservations about the Assassins. I did too, once. But, the Brotherhood is not something to be convinced of. It must be desired for its own sake, and chosen.

speaker: Edward
en: Dressed like a King, but this Saint Jerome's got the look of a Man who enjoys a drink.

speaker: Edward
en: What sort of Land is Egypt? I'd like to visit, given the Chance.

speaker: Edward
en: The Sun sliding below the Sea is a sight matched only by when it rises again.

speaker: Edward
en: A worthy Battle!

speaker: Edward
en: This reminds me of my Days in Nassau.

speaker: Edward
en: Hmmm...

speaker: Edward
en: A Man can outrun anything, except the Grave.

speaker: Edward
en: What a Ship!

speaker: Edward
en: Now that's Art.

speaker: Edward
en: Du Casse was a mindless Animal.

speaker: Bernard
en: He knew nothing of Honour or Decency. Your killing of him was well done.

speaker: Edward
en: And this Blade... I didn't know. You should take it.

speaker: Bernard
en: It belongs to you now.

speaker: Bernard
en: Quite the Collection, Captain Kenway.

speaker: Edward
en: Aye, most of them caused me Trouble.

speaker: Bernard
en: Your Companions?

speaker: Edward
en: Some, once. Seems to me that the Artist flattered a few.

speaker: Bernard
en: The Pensill's Amulets forbid to die, and vest us with a fair Eternity. Immortality, through Shape and Colour.

speaker: Edward
en: Aye. Now they haunt this Basement.

speaker: Bernard
en: chuckleI rather think they illuminate it... most of them.

speaker: Edward
en: Full sail, lads! To the east!

speaker: Anne
en: What is our course today?

speaker: Edward
en: Príncipe. The late Governor Rogers claimed that Bartholomew Roberts is there.

speaker: Anne
en: You aim to put and end to him as well?

speaker: Edward
en: Aye. The man does not value friendship nor favors. He'd be dead if it weren't for me, but the first chance he gets he hands me over to the British.

speaker: Anne
en: There was quite the price on your head, if I recall correctly.

speaker: Edward
en: Very funny. Are you planning to turn me in as well?

speaker: Anne
en: What, and captain this brig myself? The men would never have it.

speaker: Edward
en: You may be right.

speaker: Anne
en: So we're to sail halfway round the world to settle a grudge?

speaker: Edward
en: Don't forget; there's quite the price on his head as well. It would do no harm to claim it.

speaker: Anne
en: So long as there is some profit in it for all of us, beyond sating your sense of vengeance.

speaker: Bartholomew Roberts
en: Is that you, Kenway? Such a warm welcome you have laid out for me!

speaker: Edward
en: Shame it wasn't warm enough.

speaker: Bartholomew Roberts
en: Yes, yes. What a shame. I imagine you'll be trying again shortly?

speaker: Edward
en: Aye. This isn't over.

speaker: Bartholomew Roberts
en: Well. That's that, then. Can't say I'm surprised.

speaker: Edward
en: Strange words from a strange man.

speaker: Bartholomew Roberts
en: Strange to all but myself. I always knew I'd be done in by some knave pirate. But I'd be lying if I said I wouldn't have minded another year or two at this game.

speaker: Edward
en: If only it were a year or two less. I spent that time in a gibbet thanks to you.

speaker: Bartholomew Roberts
en: Quite a new perspective on life when you're looking through bars.

speaker: Edward
en: Aye, one I could have done without.

speaker: Bartholomew Roberts
en: And me as well, it would seem. No matter. Now's not the time for regrets, is it?

speaker: Edward
en: I would hope not.

speaker: Bystanders
en: (Be careful! He's got you! Break his jaw, Esteban! Pummel him! A solid hit! Harder! Right in the guts!)

speaker: Privateer
en: (Ah, wasn't that a fine job, that last one. Bled those French whelps of everything they owned, then sent them swimming home. I'm too good for this job, by God. Too talented. I should be Governor of this place. If only King Philip could hear my - )

speaker: Anne
en: Morning, Kenway. Chasing a drink so early?

speaker: Edward
en: Aye, 'tis necessary.

speaker: Anne
en: What's troubling you?

speaker: Edward
en: Turncoats, Anne. My so-called friend Hornigold now flies his sails under the command of Woodes Rogers.

speaker: Anne
en: It's seems our humble governor's pardon came with terms.

speaker: Edward
en: The man had freedom, Anne. Respect. A life worth living. Now he's aught but a puppet.

speaker: Anne
en: His choice and his problem, Edward. Not yours.

speaker: Edward
en: Were it so simple. His first order of business is to cleanse the water of us loathsome pirates.

speaker: Anne
en: So you plan to strike first, then?

speaker: Edward
en: Unless you've a better plan.

speaker: Anne
en: I don't.

speaker: Edward
en: Does Rackham know anything? He's less of a fool than he lets on.

speaker: Anne
en: Jack told me not to say anything but... not two days ago he saw Hornigold's ship anchored at Kingston for repair. They must be there at least a week. There's your chance.

speaker: Edward
en: Then I'll be back here before that week is out. Save a pint for me.

speaker: Anne
en: Be careful. Loathsome pirate you may be, I still prefer you alive to dead.

speaker: Edward
en: You've thrown in with the wrong lot, Ben. This can't go on.

speaker: Benjamin
en: Oh, but it will. Sure as I'm still standing here.

speaker: Edward
en: Next time we meet, you'll not be.

speaker: Benjamin
en: Spoken like the murderer you have become.

speaker: Benjamin
en: Edward Kenway. You damnable fool.

speaker: Edward
en: You're the fool, Ben! We had it all! A life any man could be proud of! And you went and tossed it all away.

speaker: Benjamin
en: That I did. And I've no regrets, neither.

speaker: Edward
en: Why, mate? What could the Governor have possibly offered that you didn't already have?

speaker: Benjamin
en: It's useless to try and explain it to someone who can't fathom a purpose to life other than coin and ale.

speaker: Edward
en: Is that all you think of me?

speaker: Benjamin
en: Aye. And that's being generous.

speaker: Lucy Baldwin
en: Captain! I received Word. The Barrister who forged my father's Will has been seen at Havana.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: That's worth looking into.

speaker: Edward
en: Havana is a long Way from your Grandfather's Plantation on Black Island. Are you sure about this?

speaker: Lucy
en: It makes Sense. Grandpa had a small Cabin on a Beach just north of the Town. It's a quiet place. Out of the Way. When I was very young, Mama and I would go there. If I was going to hide Something, that's where I would hide it.

speaker: Edward
en: You think the Barrister has your Gold there?

speaker: Lucy
en: That Coward wouldn't risk being seen for no reason, I know that. There's something there. The Beach with Grandad's Cabin is to the north, past the Town.

speaker: Edward
en: This Barrister seems well connected for a simple Lawer. How did your Father come to know him?

speaker: Lucy
en: For as long as I can remember he was around our Family, even before Mama died. I never liked him. He wears a big wig, has a fake smile, and stinks of Lavender.

speaker: Edward
en: There was a Letter at Black Island that said it was him who put the Red Coats on your Trail.

speaker: Lucy
en: Yes. When we find him I mean to bring that up.

speaker: Barrister
en: Spread out further! It's somewhere here.

speaker: Edward
en: Speak of the Devil. That looks like your Barrister.

speaker: Lucy
en: That's him all right.

speaker: Lucy
en: You murdering fucking Cur!

speaker: Barrister
en: Get them! Get them!

speaker: Barrister
en: Please! Spare me! I'll share it with you!

speaker: Edward
en: It's not yours to share, Mate.

speaker: Lucy
en: They buried it here somewhere.

speaker: Edward
en: There's a Spade here.

speaker: Edward
en: That's a grand Sight. There's a Letter.

speaker: Lucy
en: Show me.

speaker: Lucy
en: What? This is my Mother's.

speaker: Lucy
en: Fuck! It was Papa.

speaker: Lucy
en: I got him, Mama.

speaker: Lucy
en: You tell anyone you saw me cry, and I'll bury you next to that fucking Barrister.

speaker: Edward
en: Not a Word.

speaker: Edward
en: It's funny, that. With scurvy, the fix is more pleasant than the cause... but when you catch a dose from a whore and must treat it with quicksilver, you're fonder of getting the disease than you are of curing it. Something biting at you?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Ah... all men desire to live by a code, or a creed, yes? Yet when pressed, most defer to their instincts rather than the laws that bind them. But what is the appeal of a creed if it does not yoke all men to like behavior?

speaker: Edward
en: Might make a man feel like... he belongs to something. What's your answer?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Ah... that all men are sheep. And that an old wolf like me deserves every ounce of blood he draws. Sail to this location. Bring only those you trust.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Captain Kenway. Shall we use your ship for this next scheme, or mine?

speaker: Edward
en: I'd first hear the details before deciding.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Ah, it's a small gambit... this fount of information has just told me that a nearby galleon contains the treasure I seek. For his sake, I hope he's right.

speaker: Edward
en: You've thought this plan through?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Indeed. Using this man, we'll acquire a Portuguese flag which will get us as close to our target as possible. It's a very simple idea... if you follow my orders to the letter.

speaker: Edward
en: The Jackdaw then.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Excellent!

speaker: Edward
en: We're under-weigh, Roberts. So what's your plan?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: The flagship of this fleet is transporting a valuable treasure in a large chest. Crystal vials filled with blood. You may remember.

speaker: Edward
en: We're chasing drams of blood! Is that all?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: I asked you to follow my instructions to the letter, captain. But I did not give you leave to question why. I want those blood vials intact. And if that does not happen, we part as enemies. Do you understand?

speaker: Edward
en: I'll try to, aye. I can't place your accent, Roberts. Is it the west you come from?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Exactly right. A tiny town called Casnewydd-Bach.

speaker: Edward
en: I've not heard of it.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Aye, few have. I always fancied it should have a placard at its borders: "Welcome to Casnewydd-Bach, the town you have just passed."

speaker: Edward
en: I'm from Swansea myself.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Ah. A teeming metropolis by comparison.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: There's the thing for us, captain! You see that ship here? We'll need its flag for this ruse to work.

speaker: Edward
en: If I can steal their flag without disturbing so much as a flea, I'll do it.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: By all means, try. If this scallywag gives us away, I'll paint the quarterdeck with his brains. (Start talking, captain...)

speaker: Captive
en: (Ah... Hail, gentlemen! And God praise the magnanimous King John!)

speaker: Soldier 1
en: (God praise and protect him, sir! How are you on this beautiful evening?)

speaker: Captive
en: (Very well, very well, thank you. Uh... Just a quiet cruise around the fleet to see that you are all in... ah, in fine shape and working order. Is everything... tidy on your side?)

speaker: Soldier 1
en: (Yes, sir. Very tidy, sir! We're only waiting for our flagship to water and resupply before setting off. Oh, and I believe one of the merchant ships in our company is in need of a new mast. There's men ashore scouting for a suitable tree now.)

speaker: Soldier 1
en: (The better part of our company, sir. Out of forty-two ships in total, I'd say more than two-thirds were merchants.)

speaker: Captive
en: (Ah, a sizeable number! No doubt you'll be fearful of pirates then?)

speaker: Soldier 1
en: (Yes, sir, exactly. Hence our precautions. With so many pirates about, this fleet needs ample protection. It's no small matter to guard near three-dozen ships.)

speaker: Soldier 1
en: (I beg your pardon for asking sir, but yours isn't a ship I recognize. Ain't even sporting the King's colours.)

speaker: Captive
en: (Ah ha, yes... well, on the subject of pirates... this brig was newly liberated from a band of rogues just a few days ago. We've not found an opportunity to re-fit her.)

speaker: Captive
en: (Thank you, young man. I'll... ah... I should let you return to your duties. Call out if you should require anything else.)

speaker: Soldier 2
en: (Ah, pardon, sir. I should have asked before, but we have a bag of letters addressed to Salvador and São Paulo. Would you be heading south any time soon?)

speaker: Soldier 2
en: (Understood, sir. It never hurts to ask. All well over there, sir?)

speaker: Captive
en: (Very well, thank you! Merely taking a reckoning before setting out.)

speaker: Captive
en: (It was a pleasure talking to you young man. Give my regards to your captain.)

speaker: Edward
en: You've got the flag?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Aye. And we're flying it now. This should do nicely.

speaker: Edward
en: I'll keep my distance. Slow and steady.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Aye, the flag we stole won't protect us from eyes that pry too long.

speaker: Captive
en: (Please, sir, whatever you intend to do, I beg you to reconsider.)

speaker: Edward
en: What's he whining about?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: He's not whining. He's ecstatic!

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Up ahead! They're unloading something from that ship!

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Could that be our prize? Hm. Perhaps you should go ashore, captain Kenway. Find that chest. And if it contains the prize I seek, bring it here. We'll tell this lot we're a ship rife with plague. They'll not come near then, lest they'll catch their death.

speaker: Captive
en: (Hello! Hello! I am he! Apologies for the curtness of my reply, but I am afraid I have some bad news to relay. We may be afflicted by plague.)

speaker: Captive
en: (Infected cargo, I imagine. Look, if you'll just... ah, leave us to our situation for the time being, we will find a way to quarantine ourselves to avoid any harm to you.)

speaker: Soldier 4
en: (Plague! The captain of that brig claims they're afflicted by plague! What'll we do?)

speaker: Soldier 3
en: (Rafael! Rouse a few men and row out to that brig! They say they're stricken by plague, but I want a closer look.)

speaker: Soldier 4
en: (What's that brig doing out there? She's flying our colours, but I can't say I've seen her before.)

speaker: Soldier 5
en: (Keep an eye on that ship. She's been idling there for some time, without cause.)

speaker: Soldier 3
en: (I heard a story about some Spaniard paying our Admiral a visit. Stinks of some kind of treason if you ask me.)

speaker: Soldier 5
en: (Yes. I heard his name was Torres. Strange times these are when a Spaniard like that can go marching around the deck of one of our warships.)

speaker: Soldier 6
en: (For all my cursing of the Navy, they do us good for discipline. A gundeck should be orderly, and as clean as a whale's arse, so it's not out of spite the captain sets us to scrubbing it so. It's only common sense.)

speaker: Edward
en: The chest they hauled ashore was full of empty vials. Where's our Portuguese captain?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: He had outlived his usefulness.

speaker: Edward
en: Where is he?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Sleeping soundly at the bottom of the sea.

speaker: Edward
en: How many men must we kill for a simple prize?

speaker: Bartholomew
en: As many as drift into our path.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Look on that, Captain. Men who ran the same gauntlet, and lost their way.

speaker: Edward
en: We're made of sterner stuff, Adé.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: How often have those been a sailor's last words, I wonder? Our treasure must be aboard that galleon. Why don't you take the ship itself and save us a bit of time?

speaker: Edward
en: Aye. That's the way I'd play it.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: I can bring the Jackdaw closer, but those lookouts will be a problem.

speaker: Edward
en: Well spotted. I'll clear them off first.

speaker: Soldier 7
en: (I'm tired of this routine. And I'm not looking forward to the trip to Lisbon, either.)

speaker: Soldier 8
en: (Did you catch wind of what happened to those British pirates in Nassau? Their King George sent a man to clear 'em all out, and he seems to have done a decent job of it.)

speaker: Soldier 9
en: (It's a damned pretty evening, I ain't ashamed to say. There's been precious few like it this month.)

speaker: Soldier 10
en: (Is your starboard crew on the dogwatch this evening? Or were you on yesterday? Jaysus, I'm losing track of days out here.)

speaker: Bartholomew
en: We've been spotted... took them long enough.

speaker: Edward
en: To quarters all! Man the cannons, every last hand!

speaker: Bartholomew
en: On your command, captain. Let's hear the roar of this beast! Fight for what is owed you, lads! Nothing like the hot winds of Hell blowing in your face! No mercy for those who stand in our path!

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Here's my prize!

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Ah... the Templars have been busy I see. Laurens Prins' blood. Useless now.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: Woodes Rogers. Ben Hornigold. Even Torres himself. Small quantities, kept for a special purpose.

speaker: Edward
en: You must take me to the Observatory, Roberts. I need to know what it is.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: To what end, eh? Will you sell it from under my nose? Or work with me and use it to bolster our gains?

speaker: Edward
en: Whatever improves my lot in life.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: How ridiculous. A merry life and a short one, that's my motto. It's all the optimism I can muster.

speaker: Bartholomew
en: All right, captain Kenway. You've earned a look.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: Blackbeard's hidden his Treasure in a poxy Riddle.

speaker: Edward
en: That's a lot of Pirates for Somewhere that's meant to be secret. All this because of some paper I found in a dead Man's Hat. I hope I'm right to trust Thatch's Map.

speaker: Edward
en: Shite, Thatch. What have you started.

speaker: Edward
en: That's it. They've seen us now!

speaker: Lucy Baldwin
en: You know what this looks like? A lot of Work for me at the end of the Day, that's what.

speaker: Edward
en: This is what happens when you tell Pirates there's Treasure.

speaker: Abel Galvão
en: Just be glad there are no Spaniards in the Mix.

speaker: Edward
en: I'd almost prefer warring with the King's Navy to this.

speaker: Pirate 1
en: If the Loot is even Half of Blackbeard's Takings it's enough for all of us to live like Kings. But we have to hurry. With the Redcoats clearing out North Carolina and all, it won't be long afore they're down here as well.

speaker: Edward
en: They thought Blackbeard hid his Treasure under water.

speaker: Pirate 2
en: I heard tell that Blackbeard buried it here on his own. Left his Crew and rowed Ashore hisself.

speaker: Pirate 3
en: That's all drunk Talk. Blackbeard were too canny to let his Treasure be found easy, no matter what Captain Hands' says.

speaker: Pirate 2
en: You better hope it's True! If the Captain's wrong, we get nothing but Blisters and Thirst for all our Work.

speaker: Pirate 4
en: I told you using a Bell was madness! Now look what's happened.

speaker: Pirate 5
en: Don't blame me! You were all for it 'til the cursed Line broke.

speaker: Pirate 4
en: Our Lads are drowned for certain! This is Captain Hand's fault, dragging us out here just to die.

speaker: Pirate 5
en: How in Hell did Blackbeard manage all this?

speaker: Pirate 6
en: I ain't going back in there. There's Sharks in them Tunnels that got our Lads! I can't fathom how Blackbeard ever got through by himself.

speaker: Pirate 7
en: Leave them Powder Barrels be. Hands left 'em where they are a Purpose, and don't want no one touching 'em.

speaker: Pirate 8
en: Ah, he just couldn't carry them further with his gammy Leg. Look, no Harm will come of...

speaker: Pirate 9
en: Think, man. Where would you hide your Treasure if you was Blackbeard. Not out in the open, that's certain.

speaker: Pirate 10
en: A couple of Boys went ahead, and the Walls fell on 'em! I ain't going no further!

speaker: Pirate 11
en: We can't just leave them, the Captain will have our Heads. Grab a couple of those Barrels, and we'll blast our way through.

speaker: Pirate 10
en: Captain Hand's to blame! He's going to get us killed. It's plain Blackbeard's trapped the Cave.

speaker: Pirate 11
en: Curse you for a Coward! You'll go in, or I'll gut you where you Stand!

speaker: Pirate 10
en: Try it, Lobcock, and see where it gets you!

speaker: Israel Hands
en: I was fucking Sailing Master, not some Swab! So who did Blackbeard send to search out his Farming tools? Israel bloody Hands, that's who. And I went, bad Leg and all, like a whimpering Puppy. Well, my Day has come. I'll take my Reward and more from Blackbeard's own Treasure.

speaker: Hands
en: I served Blackbeard, and what did it get me? The miserable Bastard shot me in my knee just to prove he could. Then he gave all Reward to that prancing Dandy Kenway. Well, now I'll get my Share!

speaker: Hands
en: Edward Kenway. Now that's fucking poetry, that is. I'll settle every Debt owed me this Day.

speaker: Edward
en: Israel Hands, Thatch's Sailing Master. I thought you Dead, or lost on account of your own Navigation.

speaker: Hands
en: You were always the Favorite, thieving Reward due the rest of us. You're gonna pay for that, Kenway! And for all you ever done to me!

speaker: Edward
en: Ever the Green Eyed Minnow, Hands.

speaker: Edward
en: What the Devil...

speaker: Jackdaw pirate
en: Is that it? That's Blackbeard's Treasure?

speaker: Blackbeard
en: Whoever's reading this Letter, you best hope I'm dead, or you'll answer for disturbing what I took uncommon Pains to secure. If, in point of Fact, I am dead, with Luck it's Edward Kenway who's doing the reading, having been lured by the smell of Gold. That being the Case, I'm sorry to disappoint you, Lad. You've not found Gold. But what you have found is Treasure of sorts. Here you have Everything you'll need to establish a Freehold, and grow it into the grand Proposition we always dreamed of. It's cost me a pretty Penny too, if I'm honest, so don't go squandering it. Do right by me in this, Kenway. The World needs a Place like Nassau, as much as it ever did.

speaker: Edward
en: You soft headed old Coot.

speaker: Blackbeard
en: Now don't worry, this weren't my whole Fortune. The rest is hid safe, and there ain't no Map to it. Blackbeard.

speaker: Edward
en: Clever Bastard. All right, Thatch. I'll see to it.

speaker: Bernard Woodhouse
en: Captain Kenway. What is all this? Pieces of Eight, Shovels, Pitchforks, Plow. A farming Manual?

speaker: Edward
en: A Gift of sorts, from Blackbeard's Treasure. And there's a lot more besides.

speaker: Bernard
en: It's enough to secure the Prosperity of all the lives here. That's a strange kind of Treasure for a Pirate, is it not?

speaker: Edward
en: Blackbeard weren't a usual Pirate. Use it well. Treasure or no, it weren't easy to find.

speaker: Bernard
en: I'll make sure we do, Captain.

speaker: Blind Justice
en: was a virtual representation of one of Edward Kenway's genetic memories, relived by a research analyst at Abstergo Entertainment through the Animus Omega.

speaker: Guard
en: (Where is your cohort? Hand over the murderer now! I won't ask so nicely again! Speak or lose your tongue entirely. Bring me the killer! Or shall I take you to the Governor's prisons? Is that what you want?)

speaker: Criminal
en: The devil scratch your eyes out!

speaker: Officer
en: You are a charlatan and a scoundrel, and all of Kingston shall know it 'ere this day is out! That's right, he's a bloody empirik! A cheat selling dud medicines at preposterous prices.

speaker: Doctor
en: No, sir! I offer only proven remedial herbs! Picked from the jungles.

speaker: Officer
en: Aye, and without the express permission of the Governor! Look on his face, all. Heed the visage of a man who climbs above his station! Let this be a lesson to all! There shall be no free enterprise here without the expressed permission of the Governor!

speaker: Edward
en: It's Rhona, right?

speaker: Rhona
en: Kenway. Looking for trouble, I assume?

speaker: Edward
en: Hm... I see you haven't lost your charm.

speaker: Rhona
en: And you're still boosey as a swill tub. What do you want?

speaker: Edward
en: I've come to warn you: your life's in danger.

speaker: Rhona
en: Aren't you the crafty one? Whatever gave it away?

speaker: Edward
en: Possibly, I had a hand in selling a "sensitive document" to one of those Templar chaps you're so fond of.

speaker: Rhona
en: Congratulations. Your mission was a success.

speaker: Edward
en: How can I make amends?

speaker: Rhona
en: You sober enough for target practice?

speaker: Edward
en: Anything for a lady.

speaker: Rhona
en: Help me kill these men.

speaker: Rhona
en: I've got more than enough powder to take care of them. Drag a powder keg over there. Why not set a powder keg for more boom? Take a keg. Set a trap. Surprise them with a powder keg. Set the keg where they'll least expect it. Use a keg. Set a trap with powder kegs!

speaker: Rhona
en: They're coming from everywhere! Fire at the powder keg! They're coming from the left! Cover the right entrance. Fire a snapper at that keg! They'll come from the back. Blast a keg! I'll take care of this one. Come on then! Ah, I'm hurt! You're finished! I'm hit! A little help, please! Remember me? Your bleeding friend? Ah, a little help would be nice!

speaker: Rhona
en: So, is this your new persona? Sir Edward of Havana, rescues damsels in distress?

speaker: Edward
en: And does it suit me, mopsie?

speaker: Rhona
en: Better than your old personality. Really Edward, why are you here?

speaker: Edward
en: Yes... well, there's a key. Most likely in the pocket of your Templar suitor. I need it.

speaker: Rhona
en: Really? And why don't I want this key for myself?

speaker: Edward
en: Rhona, I know you're no stranger to a man's boots but the suit this key unlocks won't fit you.

speaker: Rhona
en: I'll tell you what: if I think of a chore that requires the help of an especially simple fellow, I'll let you know.

speaker: Bernard Woodhouse
en: Captain Kenway! A Letter's arrived at the Villa, addressed to you by way of Stede Bonnet. I've left it for you in the Trophy Room.

speaker: Edward Kenway
en: Bonnet? It's been some time since I heard News of him. Thank you.

speaker: Stede Bonnet
en: My dear Friend, Edward. After a rather unfortunate Kerfuffle with the Governor's men, I currently enjoy the Hospitalities of a Charles-Towne Jail. It's all a bit bothersome, but I have Faith I'll be freed soon. Luckily, I'd already stashed some of my Takings in the Cabin of my Ship. I've sent it ahead to Mystery Island, but the Crew can be unpredictable without a Captain. I thought you might be amenable to checking in on them. There will be Reward for the Inconvenience of course, and I'll meet you there when I manage to extricate myself. It'll be just like old times! Signed Captain Stede Bonnet.

speaker: Edward
en: Captain Stede Bonnet... now, that's unexpected.

speaker: Edward
en: Hidden Treasure and Trouble with the Authorities. You earn my Respect, Bonnet.

speaker: Edward
en: I hope Bonnet's taken real Booty, and isn't hoarding Sugar or the like.

speaker: Lucy Baldwin
en: I wonder what Bonnet's got up to, since he sailed off into yonder Sunset.

speaker: Edward
en: He was quite the sight, wasn't he? From the Silk and Velvet of Barbados, to his own Captain's Helm.

speaker: Lucy
en: Aye. The man wasn't cut from the same Cloth as the rest of Nassau, that's for sure.

speaker: Edward
en: Is that a hint of Fondness I hear, Lucy?

speaker: Lucy
en: I've no Love for the Posturing of Captains, present company excluded.

speaker: Edward
en: Naturally.

speaker: Lucy
en: Bonnet struck me as a different sort.

speaker: Edward
en: His ways aren't as Rough as Thatch or Vane's. But I can't say if that's a good thing.

speaker: Edward
en: A Schooner's run aground. Could be Bonnet.

speaker: Edward
en: The Revenge. This is Bonnet's Tub.

speaker: Edward
en: Locked tight.

speaker: Rowland Sharp
